name: Example Portal

signIn.description: Open the app; it redirects to the sign-in page. Choose a person card, or fill in the form.

signOut.description: Press Sign out in the header.

notes: environment is local, shared or production. production needs DEMO_ALLOW_PRODUCTION=1 to record. For a form sign-in use kind "form" with "fields": {"#user": "{name}", "#pass": "{env:DEMO_PASSWORD}"} and "submit": "#login".
